item.title: The Type-Switched Variadic System I Keep Reusing in Go
item.author: technicalblog123@arran4.com (Arran Ubels)
item.description: I keep reaching for the same API shape in Go: a variadic argument list (...any) processed with a type switch. I call it my type-switched variadic system. It is not the only way to configure behavior in Go, but for parser/consumer style libraries it has been one of the most productive patterns I use.
